column1: # Redmine 1031 phase 1 baseline: generated SQL hash per saved search.
# session.flatTableName=flat (internal user class), 523 of 523 entries OK,
# Each line is a cf_canned_search.canned_id and the MD5 of the SQL that
# /includes/SearchSql.cfm generates for that saved search's criteria, over the
# report body from the basJoin marker to the END marker.
# Keyed on canned_id rather than sequence, because the corpus changes whenever a
# user saves or deletes a search. After phase 3, re-run the harness with
# ?compare=1 to list only the entries whose hash moved.
